blocks.source:
[[content]]
id = "examples"
owner = "project"
repository = "diplodocus"
path = "docs/examples"
mount = "examples"
format = "qmd"

[content.execution]
mode = "execute"
engine = "jupyter"
kernel = "python3"
declared-environment-inputs = ["devenv.lock"]
